lore: Every save the shoals keep is copied into the mangroves, where the roots hold it through the storm season. Storms twist a few roots each night. The warden walks the root tree at dawn: where a root's knot matches the shore, she skips the whole branch; where it doesn't, she follows it down to the twisted saves. The tide gives her only so many steps.

lines.start: Twelve hundred saves on the shore, twelve hundred in the roots. Let's see what the storm twisted.
lines.storm: Storm's through. Some roots are twisted; the knots will tell us which.
lines.sync: Knots match up here, skip the branch. That one's off, follow it down.
lines.win: Every dawn the roots matched the shore again, and the tide never caught us.
lines.fail: The tide came in before I finished the walk. The roots still disagree.
